# repeat.py

[简体中文](repeat.zh.md) ｜ **English** ｜ [← Back to README](../../README.en.md)

Repetition: grid, circular and linear.

This file contains a single class, `RepeatMixin`, a mixin that `board/__init__.py` composes into `MagicPen`.

---

## Classes and methods

### `RepeatMixin`

RepeatMixin - repetition: grid, circular and linear.

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `repeat_around_circle(el, count, center=None, angle_gap=None, clockwise=True, rotate_with=True)` | Circular repeat: copy an element count times around a circle. |
| `repeat_grid(el, cols, col_gap, rows, row_gap, grid_type=GridRepeatT…)` | Grid repeat. |
| `repeat_horizontal(el, count, gap, align='center', fill_gaps=False)` | Horizontal repeat. |
| `repeat_vertical(el, count, gap, align='center', fill_gaps=False)` | Vertical repeat; see repeat_horizontal for an example. |
